generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years. i.e.2021-22 TO 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Rs 25.00 Lakhs (Performance Certificate certified by Not less than the ranking of EE)
Executed in one year (for a continuous period of 12 months) in last five years.2021-22-2025-26 the following minimum quantities of work EARTH WORK - 712.80 CUM, HDPE Pipeline - 2872 Mtr

UNCONDITIONAL liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 15.00 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from Nationalized / Scheduled banks for meeting the fund requirement etc). (Usually not less than 30% of the estimated cash flow) format as enclosed below
